title: Stored XSS in user profile bio field
summary: Bio field accepts and reflects arbitrary HTML/JS without sanitization
notes: Payload: <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> stored and reflected on GET /users/<id>

details.evidence: Stored payload <script>alert(1)</script> executed in victim session; captured in scans/xss_poc.txt
details.impact: Authenticated attacker can steal session cookies or perform actions as any viewing user
details.remediation: Apply HTML output encoding and a strict Content-Security-Policy; validate bio input server-side
steps_to_reproduce: Log in as a second user and visit /users/<attacker-id>
Observe script execution in victim browser
